senses.gloss:
m. (-श्यः)
The painted or white footed antelope.
E.
ऋष to go, क्यप् affix; also ऋष्य and रिश्य.

m. (-ष्यः)
The painted or white footed antelope.
n. (-ष्यं)
A sort of leprosy.
E.
ऋष to go, क्यप् affix: also ऋश्य and रिश्य.

m. (-तुः)
A name of ANIRUDDHA the son of KANDARPA.
E.
ऋष्य and केतु a sign; having a deer for his symbol: some read this दिश्वकेतु, and others ऋश्यकेतु, ऋष्यकेतन, रिष्यकेतु, &c.

f. (-ता)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
E.
ऋषि and अ before गत gone.

f. (-न्धा)
A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus): see वृद्धताडक.
E.
ऋषि, अ priv. and गन्ध smell.

n. (-ह्वं)
A sort of leprosy.
E.
ऋष्य the deer and जिह्वा the tongue; to which the blotches are compared.

f. (-क्ता)
1 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
2 Asparagus racemosus.
3 Sida, (cordifolia and rhombifolia.)
E.
see ऋषिप्रोक्ता.

m. (-कः)
A mountain in the Dekhin, the temporary abode of RĀMA with the monkey chief SUGRĪVA.
E.
ऋष्य a deer, मूक dumb.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The name of a holy sage celebrated in the first book of the Rāmāyaṇa.
